# `tools/inspector/InspectorConfigFactory.js`

> **Source:** `engine/tools/inspector/InspectorConfigFactory.js`

InspectorConfigFactory.js - Factory for creating inspector configurations Simplifies the creation of inspector config objects by providing standard getters/setters for common state.

## Functions

### `createInspectorConfig(options)`

Create a standard inspector configuration.

**Parameters:**

- `options` *(Object)* — Configuration options
- `options.ecs` *(Object)* — ECS state { world, lightEntity, selectedEntityId, inspectorApi }
- `options.spawn` *(Object)* — Spawn state { pendingPosition, basePosition, ghostOffset, pendingType }
- `options.render` *(Object)* — Render state { shaderMode, enableDiffuse, enableBounce, etc. }
- `options.physics` *(Object)* — Physics state { enabled, gravityScale, staticFriction, etc. }
- `options.particles` *(Object)* — Particle state { instanceCount, emitters }
- `options.spawnedEntities` *(Array)* — Array of spawned entity objects
- `options.spawnObjectAtPosition` *(Function)* — Spawn function
- `options.spawnParticlesAtPosition` *(Function)* — Particle spawn function
- `options.deleteEntityById` *(Function)* — Delete function
- `options.uiElements` *(Object)* — Optional UI elements { brightnessSlider, brightnessValue }
- `options.logger` *(Function)* — Optional logger

**Returns:** Inspector configuration
